text:
incident-bot: ALERT - inference-runtime-prod high 5xx rate detected (service=inference-runtime, threshold=2% over 5m) - link: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234

pagerduty-bot: Page triggered for on-call: alex (priority P1) — escalation in 2m if unacknowledged :rotating_light:

alex: ack, I'm on it. looking at grafana now. can someone post current error % + traffic?

maria: alex fyi seeing a spike from model: llm-large-v2, error 5xx mainly 503/504 — upstream timeout from the gpu-worker pool. queue length jumping.

alex: ok. initial commands: checking worker pods and recent deploys
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs --tail=200 <gpu-worker-pod> | tail -n 80
```

alex: pod restarts: 3 of 12 in the last 10m on host gpu-node-07, oom/killed? looks like OOM in the python process, but also spike in rpc timeouts.

sam: could be batch size change from last deploy. i see a config roll two deploys ago changed default batch_size=64 -> 128 for llm-large-v2. i'm reverting canary to 64 for now. pushing patch to canary config.

priyanka: meanwhile routing fallback: can we route traffic for llm-large-v2 to llm-medium-v2 (slightly smaller) for external customers only? reduces cost but preserves latency.

alex: yes. adding temporary routing rule to route 30% traffic to llm-medium-v2 and keep 70% to large. applying now.

incident-bot: ACTION - route-change applied by alex at 1802000065: /routes/llm-large-v2 -> split 70/30 to fallback.

maria: after routing change error rate dropped from ~6.8% to ~2.1% in 3m. latency 95th also down ~200ms. looks like fallback helped.

alex: i'm scaling up gpu-worker pool by +2 replicas to absorb burst. doing a rolling restart of three problematic pods to clear stale KV caches.

sam: thanks. can we mute the noisy alert for the next 15m while things stabilize? current threshold is firing a bunch due to noisy transient.

alex: muting alert 1802000000 (5xx-rate) for 15m with runbook tag incident-1802000000.

incident-bot: NOTE - Alert 5xx-rate muted by alex until +900s.

priyanka: customer-impact assessment: we saw ~0.3% of paying requests hit errors that returned 503. majority were internal retries caught by client-side. only two customers reported degraded responses. I'll open a support ticket and notify CS.

maria: also logged: root cause appears to be combined effect of increased batch size + a memory regression in llm-large-v2 that surfaced under sustained QPS.

alex: thanks team. I'm handing off to sam for night coverage in 10m. sam: you have ops runbook link and muted alert context.

sam: taking over. quick notes: revert batch_size permanently? or we should patch model to fix mem regression first?

maria: short term: keep batch_size=64 for large-v2 and monitor for 24h. long term: team-ml to patch memory regression (PR already opened: github.com/redwood/llm/PR/482).

priyanka: post-incident tasks:
- tune 5xx alert: increase threshold to 3% over 10m to reduce noise during autoscale events
- add suppression during deploy windows (use label cluster=canary)
- create dedicated incident retrospective dashboard in Grafana (panels + drilldowns)

alex: +1. scheduling a quick retro tomorrow 15:00 UTC. will capture config diffs. Sam, you're owner for alert tuning. Maria owns dashboard work with product metrics.

sam: I'll open a ticket for alert tuning. proposed PromQL for 5xx %:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-runtime",status=~"5.."}[10m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-runtime"}[10m])) * 100
```
Set alert if > 3 for 10m and link to runbook. Also add `cluster!~"canary"` label to avoid canary noise.

maria: for the retrospective Grafana dashboard, suggested panels:
- Golden signals: 5xx %, p95 latency (generation time), request rate (RPS)
- Backend signals: GPU utilization per node, GPU memory used, process OOMs, worker restart rate
- Queueing: inference queue length, avg wait time, batch sizes over time
- Model-level: per-model error rate, per-model latency, KV cache hit rate
- Customer impact: errors by customer id (top 10), 95th lat by plan (free/pro)
- Drilldowns: panel links to per-node logs (Loki) and per-model trace view (Tempo)

maria: example panel query for p95 latency (Prometheus + histogram quantile):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-runtime"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```
And a GPU memory panel using node exporter/gpu exporter metrics: `nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes - nvidia_gpu_memory_free_bytes`

alex: include an annotations row for deploys and config changes so dips/spikes align with deploy times. use the `deploys` datasource (we have it in grafana).

priyanka: also add an incident timeline panel (text) summarizing root cause, mitigation steps, customer impact, and assigned follow-ups with links to tickets.

sam: i'll implement the alert change and create the Grafana dashboard branch. Maria, can you review panel layout and queries?

maria: yes. I'll draft a dashboard JSON export and share the PR. tentative panel ids and templates: use variable `model` to filter per-model and `node` for per-node drilldowns. make sure panels link to `query=~` views.

alex: final perf note: consider adding a heuristic to throttle batch size dynamically if node memory > 90% to avoid OOM cascades. file an infra/auto-tuning task.

priyanka: action items:
- sam: change alert threshold + add canary suppression (due: 48h)
- maria: dashboard PR with panels + annotations (due: 72h)
- ml-team: memory regression patch for llm-large-v2 (tracking PR 482)
- alex: follow up on pod oom mitigation and autoscale tuning (due: 24h)

sam: noted. I'm on-call. leave any follow-ups here or create tickets.

alex: thanks everyone. leaving on-call to sam at 1802000480.

incident-bot: HANDOFF - on-call changed to sam at 1802000480.

pagerduty-bot: Incident closed -> severity downgraded to P3 after mitigation and monitoring. :white_check_mark:
